Name: Custom Furniture - Index Number Template
Author: eleseaHonu
Description:
This is a Numbered Template for Custom Furniture Tilesheets, allowing you to easily determine the Index Number for each piece of Furniture you place.

It is complete and compatible with the U1.5 Furniture Tilesheet.

I've also included a Version with a Transparent Background.

I've triple-checked all the numbers, but they do begin to swim when they get into the thousands, so please let me know if you find any errors and I'll happily fix them.
